abilities.name: World Runes
abilities.effect: Add 1 Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain to your library for each friendly Alarith unit on the battlefield. Add 1 Oreali, Rune of the Wind to your library for each friendly Hurakan unit on the battlefield. Add 1 Ydriliqi, Rune of the River to your library for each friendly Ydrilan unit on the battlefield. You can have a maximum of 6 of each type of rune in your library.

abilities.name: Entreat Spirit
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: You can use this ability if you have 3 or more runes in your library. Pick a friendly non-Unique Monster unit that has been destroyed to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove any 3 runes from your library. Then, set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 6" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. Allocate 6 damage points to the replacement unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

abilities.name: Depict Rune
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: You must use this ability.
abilities.effect: Remove all runes from your battle scripture. Then, pick any number of runes to remove from your library and depict them on your battle scripture. Runes removed from your library in this way are removed for the rest of the battle. Designer's Note: *Runes are used to activate powerful abilities on your units' warscrolls.*

abilities.name: The Realms Fight Back
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature. Then, pick an enemy unit within 6" of that terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 and apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn. **1 *Eruption of Earth:* Inflict 3 mortal damage on the target. 2 *Howling Winds:* Subtract 5 from the target's control score. 3 *Flash Flood:*** The target has Strike-last.

powers.name: Vexing Spirits
powers.declare: Pick a friendly Aelementiri Conclve Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
powers.effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands.

abilities.name: Scything Blade
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic in one direction (see 'The Pendulum Swings'). It can pass through models during that move and can end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move or that are within 1/2" of it to be the targets. Roll a D6 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: The Pendulum Swings
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot use Charge or Fight abilities. In addition, when this Manifestation moves, it must move in a straight line either in the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing or in the opposite direction to the direction in which the tip of the pendulum blade is pointing

summon.name: Summon Aethervoid Pendulum
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Aethervoid Pendulumon the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Aethervoid Pendulum wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Mechanisms of Time
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: If there are any friendly Wizards within 3" of this Manifestation, pick 1 of the following effects: *Increase Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation. *Decrease Time Flow*: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Wizards while they are wholly within 12" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Chronomantic Cogs
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Chronomantic Cogs endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Chronomantic Cogs endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Dancing Blades
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted by this Manifestation's attacks.

summon.name: Summon Quicksilver Swords
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Quicksilver Swords endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Quicksilver Swords endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Harbinger of Horror
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this Manifestation's shooting attacks this phase to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of models in the target unit that were slain this phase, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

summon.name: Summon Horrorghast
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Horrorghast endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Horrorghast endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Traverse the Tides of Death
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Wizard Hero within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set them up again on the battlefield within 3" of this Manifestation and not in combat. Then, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Lauchon the Soulseeker
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Lauchon the Soulseeker endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Translocation
abilities.effect: Pick a part of this Manifestation, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part and more than 3" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Soul-drain
abilities.effect: Each time an enemy unit uses a Move ability while it is within 9" of any parts of this Manifestation, the effects of the 'Fly' ability do not apply to that unit. Enemy units cannot be set up within 9" of either part of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Shards of Valagharr
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Shards of Valagharr endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Shards of Valagharr endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Shards of Valagharr endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Deathly Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 6" of one part of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the other part of this Manifestation and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulscream Bridge
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulscream Bridge endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulscream Bridge wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulscream Bridge has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Devourer of Magics
abilities.effect: If this Manifestation destroyed any enemy Manifestations this turn, Heal (6) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Arcane Predator
abilities.effect: You can add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this Manifestation, to a maximum of 3, while it is within 18" of any enemy Manifestations, but if you do so, it must end the charge move within 1/2" of an enemy Manifestation.

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation is targeted by the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

summon.name: Summon Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Krondspine Incarnate of Ghur endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Morbid Detonation
abilities.declare: You must, and can only, use this ability if this unit has 6 maelstrom points. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, this Manifestation is destroyed.

abilities.name: Necrotic Vortex
abilities.effect: Give this Manifestation 1 maelstrom point each time: • This Manifestation is set up. • A unit successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this Manifestation. • A model is slain within 12" of this Manifestation. This Manifestation can have a maximum of 6 maelstrom points at once.

summon.name: Summon Malevolent Maelstrom
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a a Malevolent Maelstrom endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: End Given Form
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Pull of the Nadir
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for friendly and enemy units while they are within 3" of this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Purple Sun of Shyish
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Purple Sun of Shyish endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Bound for the Great Oubliette
abilities.declare: For each part of this Manifestation, you can pick an enemy unit within 3" of that part to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+: • Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. • Subtract a number of inches equal to the roll from the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

summon.name: Summon Soulsnare Shackles
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Soulsnare Shackles endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Soulsnare Shackles endless spell wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. A Soulsnare Shackles endless spell has 3 parts that must each be set up within 3" of at least 1 other part.

abilities.name: Pulled to the Grave
abilities.effect: This Manifestation can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through models during that move but cannot end that move in combat. Then, you can pick an enemy unit that this Manifestation passed across during that move to be the target. Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Suffocating Gravetide
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Suffocating Gravetide endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Suffocating Gravetide endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Tendrils of Light and Shadow
abilities.effect: Enemy units cannot use commands while they are within 3" of either part of this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play. Each time this Manifestation moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other. Each part of this Manifestation is armed with Tendrils of Light and Shadow.

summon.name: Summon Geminids of Uhl-Gysh
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizardto cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Geminids of Uhl-Gysh endless spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Blinding Light
abilities.effect: This Manifestation cannot be targeted by shooting attacks. In addition, a unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks if it is impossible to draw a straight line from a model in the attacking unit to a model in the target unit without that line passing across this Manifestation.

summon.name: Summon Prismatic Palisade
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Prismatic Palisade endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Prismatic Palisade wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.effect: When a number of damage points equal to this Manifestation's Health characteristic are allocated to it, this Manifestation is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Arcane Passage
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Wizard within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: The next time the target uses a non-Summon Spell ability this phase, add 1 to the casting value of that spell. When picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from either part of this Manifestation instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to either part of this Manifestation instead of to the caster for the purposes of the 'Unbind' ability.

summon.name: Summon Umbral Spellportal
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Umbral Spellportal endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up an Umbral Spellportal wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them. An Umbral Spellportal has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.

abilities.name: Restored Vigour
abilities.effect: Heal (3) this Manifestation.

abilities.name: Bounteous Healing
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.
abilities.effect: Heal (3) the target.

summon.name: Summon Emerald Lifeswarm
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Emerald Lifeswarm endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Ravening Hunger
abilities.declare: If this Manifestation charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

summon.name: Summon Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws
summon.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell on the battlefield, pick a friendly Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
summon.effect: Set up a Ravenak's Gnashing Jaws endless spell wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

weapons.name: Burning Breath
weapons.ability: Shoot in Combat, Anti-WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)

abilities.name: Burning Up
abilities.effect: Each time this Manifestation uses a Shoot ability, after that ability has been resolved, allocate 1 damage point to this Manifestation (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point).

abilities.name: Aelementor Focus
abilities.declare: Pick a terrain feature to be the target.
abilities.effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next Spell ability used by this unit from the target instead of from this unit.

abilities.name: World-mage
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each unique rune depicted on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Shrine Guardian
abilities.effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian: • This terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 6" and can use non-command non-Charge Move abilities as if it were a unit. It cannot end a Move ability within the combat range of an enemy unit. • The Shrine Guardian cannot use Move abilities and remains on this terrain feature each time it moves. • Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Shrine Guardian, measure to this terrain feature instead. • All attacks that would target the Shrine Guardian target this terrain feature instead. • If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shrine Guardian. Then, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian. If it is not possible to set up the Shrine Guardian, it is slain.

abilities.name: Enter the Shrine
abilities.declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shrine Guardian, pick a friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords Infantry Hero within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shrine Guardian (see 'Shrine Guardian').

abilities.name: Cleansing Rituals
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a Spell ability for a Lumineth Realm-lords unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature
abilities.effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian, you can re-roll the casting roll for that spell.

abilities.name: Exit the Shrine
abilities.effect: If this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian.

abilities.name: Strength of Stone
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Alarith Stoneguard unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn: • Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's melee weapons. • The target cannot make pile-in moves.

abilities.name: Raise the Earth
abilities.declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a non-Fly unit (friendly or enemy) that is contesting the target objective uses a Move ability, inflict D6 mortal damage on that unit after that ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Elemental Endurance
abilities.effect: If this unit is picked to be a target of the 'Depict Rune' ability, for the rest of that battle round, when resolving the damage sequence for a friendly Lumineth Realm-lords unit while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, if you spend rage dice as part of the 'Fight Through the Pain' ability, remove 1 damage point from that unit's damage pool on a 2+ instead of a 3+.

abilities.name: Earth's Grip
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is gripped until this unit is destroyed, the target breaks free or you pick a different target for this spell. While the target is gripped, each time it uses a Move ability, your opponent must roll a dice as a reaction and add their fury level to the roll. On a 7+, the target breaks free. Otherwise, that Move ability has no effect.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Firestealer Hammers is 4.

abilities.name: Call of the Mountains
abilities.effect: While a visible friendly Alarith unit is wholly within 12" of this unit: • You are treated as having 1 additional instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture for the purposes of the abilities on that unit's warscroll. • If that unit is picked to be the target of the 'Depict Rune' ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Bulwark
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while that enemy unit is in combat with this unit, all attacks made by models in that unit within this unit's combat range must target this unit.

abilities.name: With the Force of a Landslide
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Firestealer Hammers for each instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Windleap
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly Hurakan units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

abilities.name: Transporting Vortex
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Lumineth Realm‑lords unit wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

units.name: Sevireth, Lord of the Seventh Wind

abilities.name: Call of the Winds
abilities.effect: While a visible friendly Hurakan unit is wholly within 12" of this unit: • You are treated as having 1 additional instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture for the purposes of the abilities on that unit's warscroll. • If that unit is picked to be the target of the 'Depict Rune' ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Searing Desert Winds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 6" of this unit this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Wind
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit used a Shoot ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture. It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stoneheart Worldhammer is 3.

abilities.name: Rain of Stone
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. Add 2 to the roll if the target charged this turn. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: With the Force of a Landslide
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Stoneheart Worldhammer for each instance of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture.

abilities.name: Fortitude of the Earth
abilities.effect: While you have 2 or more instances of Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain depicted on your battle scripture, this unit's Save characteristic is 3+.

abilities.name: Hunters of Majestic Beasts
abilities.effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit's Bow of the Wind's Vengeance is 3 for attacks that target Monsters.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Wind
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit used a Shoot ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture. It cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Hurricane Winds
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's shooting attacks to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has Strike-last for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Guided by the Winds
abilities.effect: While you have 2 or more instances of Oreali, Rune of the Wind depicted on your battle scripture, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's Windcharger Bows.

abilities.name: Myari Lightcaller
abilities.effect: While this unit's Myari Lightcaller is on the battlefield, it has Wizard (1) and the Scinari keyword.

abilities.name: Dazzling Light
abilities.declare: Pick an objective that you do not control that is within 18" of and visible to this unit's Myari Lightcaller, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that are contesting that objective.

abilities.name: Relentless as the Driving Current
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units but must end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Travel the Waterways
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked to depict Ydriliqui, Rune of the River on your battle scripture this battle round, you can instead set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
